steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: AHHHHH!!! What the **** was that?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's a trap! Watch out!
A pipe sweeps head-on to Hella, she reflexively leans back to dodge it, but another one swings out from the other direction and sends her up in the air.
If Nightmare had not grabbed her in time, the regenerating Sinner would have fallen into the suddenly opened crypt below, and no one knows what awaits her there.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This road is set up with traps? Is it the defense system of Drifter Camp?
Ten minutes ago.

steps.speaker: Executive Officer
steps.content: Headquarters, Headquarters! Requesting backup... requesting backup...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: It seems that trouble has found us...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Established as self-defense in response to gang harassment, the Drifter Camp's forces don't pursue violent weapons, relying more on the complex terrain and traps to fight in local streets and alleys.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: They don't have uniforms, but all tend to conceal themselves, preferring to wear cloaks and masks and act cautiously to avoid attracting unwanted attention.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Like Drifter Camp, these people have been struggling to survive. They are used to being oppressed, keeping a low profile, and holding back. Once such people raise their guns against you...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: It must be a desperate situation for them, and there's no escaping for you.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Then there are two kinds of situations.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do they want to kill me or capture me alive? I think the odds of the former are slim.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I have no dealings with them and have no power or intention to mess with the situation in West District. If they've come so far as to take it up to DisCity authorities, there are more suitable targets for assassination.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Instead, taking me hostage will give them some bargaining leverage.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Haha, haha... Why? Are you trying to pull that trick where you get kidnapped again? Please don't. That scary adjutant will have my head for this.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Don't try to infiltrate as a hostage. Even if they keep you alive, they will never take you back to their base. It is more likely that they will disguise themselves as gangsters and take you elsewhere to negotiate terms.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: They would never risk leading the trouble back to Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Then, will they  hand me over to Parma?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...I can't rule that out, but I don't think they would. And...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I hope you are not asking this question with some wild expectations.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: All right, I won't fall into their hands.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let them take me for a walk. I'll play my part, and I trust you to come to the rescue—our undercover agent, the "insurance measure."

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Hehe... I shouldn't have called you back.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Don't worry. I'm already on my way. Langley has instructed me to assist you, so I will.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: But until then, the communication between us will be cut off. Please play it safe, don't make things unmanageable, and get killed before I arrive...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: As long as you can survive, I will send you to Drifter Camp as promised.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ouch... This **** is more annoying than MBCC!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Calm down. These are all ordinary traps.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There is no contamination, and they're not as powerful as Mania weapons. Just figure out the patterns and don't get hit.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We won't be beaten by those.
You look at the young man in the front, who's not limping or trembling anymore. He could make a good actor, and they've planned a big game to catch you.
Then the game is on. You should stall for as long as possible and try to figure out the intentions of Drifter Camp.
